title: Opening: name pronunciation and restarting the tape
summary: Dick Allen has Johnny DeDroit give the pronunciation of his name and re-records the date and place after a machine failure.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: All right, Johnny Deidroy, take 378. No. Give me your name again, Johnny. The correct pronunciation.
Well, the correct pronunciation is De-Draw.
Johnny De-Draw. Better known as Johnny De-Droy, and sometimes Johnny De-Troy.

And it didn't register before, so I'll put the date down again. We're here at the Howard Tilt Memorial Library, the Jazz Archive, March the 16th, is right? Yes. In 1973. And your name? Dexter Thompson. And my name is Dick Allen. So, since the machine didn't work before, let's try and see if you can answer that question again as well.
It was perfect. I'm with you. Help yourself.
Okay. The question was what, about your first band?
